title: Offences by police officer
question: What does Police Act 2020 section 96 say about offences by police officer?
shortAnswer: Police Act 2020 s.96 — Police officer offences: disobedience, neglect, corruption, assault, drunk on duty.
legalExplanation:
**Section 96 of the Nigeria Police Act 2020** provides:

Police officer offences: disobedience, neglect, corruption, assault, drunk on duty

This section is part of the Police Act 2020 which replaced the old Police Act Cap P19 LFN 2004. It aims to provide a more efficient police service based on accountability, human rights protection, and community partnership.
practicalOptions: Stay calm. Ask "Am I under arrest?" and "What for?". Do not resist. Ask for lawyer. Note officer name/number. Demand court within 24 hours or release.
whatToAvoid: Do not run, bribe, argue aggressively, delete phone data, or sign statements without lawyer.
whatToDocument: Officer name, rank, station, vehicle plate, time, location, witnesses, injuries, phone/video if safe.
whatToDoAfter: Get lawyer. File complaint at PCR Unit (0800-727-3727). Demand court within 24h or release. Document injuries medically.
